name: Verdant Note
summary: At Camp Narache, a summons calls promising young tauren to seek Gart Mistrunner. Grull Hawkwind delivers the message on Gart's behalf.

sections.title: A Summons to the Path
sections.body: On the Red Cloud Mesa, Grull Hawkwind gives young tauren a message from a messenger sent by Gart Mistrunner. The summons calls those showing natural gifts to take up their responsibilities. It invites them to enter the ancient practice of tauren druidism and turn from simple village errands toward the balance of the plains.

sections.title: Voices of the Earthmother
sections.body: Gart Mistrunner warns that ancestral and natural spirits have grown restless across Mulgore. Tauren druids act as living avatars of nature, keeping harmony with the Earthmother's will despite distant rivalries. Night elves practice druidic arts too, but Gart says their pride blinds them to the tauren's deep bond with the natural realm.

faq.answer: The Verdant Note summons young tauren druids to seek Gart Mistrunner at Camp Narache and begin training in the druidic arts.

faq.q: Who delivers the note to the player?
faq.answer: Grull Hawkwind hands the note to the young druid and says a messenger sent by Gart Mistrunner was searching for them.

faq.q: Where can Gart Mistrunner be found?
faq.answer: Gart Mistrunner can be found at Camp Narache, beneath the shelter of its natural bluffs, where he trains novice tauren druids.

faq.q: Why does Gart Mistrunner warn against the night elves?
faq.answer: Gart Mistrunner says night elf pride blinds them to the tauren's deep bond with nature. He urges his student to focus on the Earthmother's wisdom.

faq.q: Why are the spirits in Mulgore restless?
faq.answer: Gart Mistrunner senses ancestral and natural spirits stirring across Mulgore. Their unrest marks the new druid's lifelong responsibility to balance the wild.

faq.q: What ability does Gart teach next after completing this quest?
faq.answer: After the young druid reports to Gart Mistrunner, he becomes their trainer and promises to teach the Earthmother's gifts as they grow in wisdom.

angles.text: As a tauren, you inherit druidism as a sacred covenant rooted in devotion to the Earthmother.
As a druid, you begin learning to channel the wild energies and restless spirits of Azeroth.
As a member of the Horde, you join the tauren druids, who bridge the faction and Kalimdor's natural mysteries while balancing its martial strength.
